cases.prompt: We need /actuator/health open, /api/** stateless with JWT, and everything else requiring a logged-in browser user. How do we configure it?
expectations: Declares three SecurityFilterChain beans with explicit securityMatcher values and @Order, catch-all last
Sets SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS only on the API chain and keeps form login on the browser chain
Disables CSRF on the bearer chain only and leaves it enabled where cookies carry the session

cases.prompt: Our @PreAuthorize expressions do nothing and every authenticated user can archive any invoice.
expectations: Checks for @EnableMethodSecurity and for the annotation sitting on a public method of a proxied bean
Explains self-invocation and manual instantiation bypass the proxy
Adds a deny-path test per rule and checks the authority naming convention against hasRole versus hasAuthority

cases.prompt: Review our resource server setup: we decode with the issuer metadata, validate the issuer, and read the scope claim. What is missing?
expectations: Requires audience validation when the token is not minted for this service alone
Requires rejection of unexpected algorithms and mentions key rotation with a refetch on an unknown kid
Keeps clock skew at zero unless justified and requires a test for expired, wrong issuer, and wrong audience

cases.prompt: We disabled CSRF because our API returns 403 on POST from the browser. Is that right?
expectations: Distinguishes bearer header authentication from cookie sessions
Keeps CSRF enabled for cookie-based flows and configures a token repository plus the request handler
Requires a csrf() post processor in tests instead of a global disable

cases.prompt: Our async job runs with no authentication and throws when it reads SecurityContextHolder. The controller works fine.
expectations: Explains the request-scoped context is not present on another thread or in a scheduled task
Uses DelegatingSecurityContextExecutor or passes the identity explicitly and clears the context afterwards
Keeps the default thread-local strategy and rejects inheritable thread locals with virtual threads

cases.prompt: Set up password storage and secrets for a Spring Boot service that authenticates users from the database.
expectations: Declares a PasswordEncoder bean with the delegating encoder so algorithm prefixes are stored
Sets a deliberate BCrypt strength and requires rehash on successful login during a strength increase
Moves secrets to the environment, forbids secrets in application.yaml, and limits actuator exposure
